svg.aria-label: Ripple, a crab, stands on the sand beside a grid of square cells, 9 across and 6 down. The top row is hot, 100, and coloured red; the other edges are cold, 0, and blue. The inner cells shade from orange near the top to blue near the bottom, the steady temperatures of a heated plate. 1 inner cell and its 4 neighbours are outlined in white. A tag says each cell becomes the mean of its 4 neighbours.
